title: Digital Marketing and CRM Specialist (Hubspot)
description:
Our client supplies specialist products to customers across the transport sector. It's an established business with a reach well beyond the UK, and its EMEA marketing team has plenty happening. They're looking for someone who can bring their digital and CRM experience to the team and make a real impact across the region.

The Role - DIGITAL MARKETING & CRM SPECIALIST

If you know your way around HubSpot and want more room to use it properly, this could be a very good next step. You'll take ownership of the CRM across EMEA while working on websites, marketing automation and the digital journeys that turn interest into enquiries. You'll be working closely with sales and marketing colleagues in different countries, helping them get more from HubSpot and giving them a clearer picture of what's working. It's a varied, hands-on role with the freedom to spot an opportunity and do something about it.

Key Responsibilities - DIGITAL MARKETING & CRM SPECIALIST
- Take day-to-day ownership of HubSpot across EMEA, from contact data and segmentation to workflows and reporting.
- Help sales and marketing teams use the CRM consistently and follow up leads effectively.
- Build and improve automated campaigns and lead nurturing journeys.
- Keep the regional websites and ecommerce platform up to date, including product content and landing pages.
- Use analytics to improve website journeys, engagement and conversions.
- Support SEO and keep an eye on how customers are finding businesses through search and AI tools.
- Work with colleagues, agencies and global stakeholders to turn ideas into improvements.

About You - DIGITAL MARKETING & CRM SPECIALIST

You're a capable digital marketer with strong, practical HubSpot experience. That's the essential bit. You understand how CRM supports both marketing and sales, and you're comfortable getting into the detail of data, campaigns and reporting.

Experience with websites, marketing automation and SEO would be useful, as would a background in B2 B or a technical industry. If you speak French or German, even better, but neither language is essential. What matters most is that you're organised, enjoy working with different people and are ready to take more ownership in a role with international scope.

The office is near Colchester. You'll work there every day for your first two weeks while you get to know the business and the team and after that, it's a hybrid arrangement with two days a week in the office.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
We re looking for a proactive, versatile and commercially minded Marketing Executive to join a developing marketing team within a global, growing organisation. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, embraces new challenges and wants to make a real difference to a business s marketing presence across Europe.

If you re a creative and organised marketing professional who enjoys variety, takes pride in delivering results and is ready to take the next step in your career, we d love to hear from you.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to get involved in a broad range of marketing activities, including:
- Digital campaigns: Support the delivery of engaging campaigns across email, social media and online channels
- Website & content: Maintain website content and ensure messaging is accurate, relevant and engaging
- Creative communications: Produce compelling copy, newsletters, presentations and marketing materials for a variety of audiences
- Brand & PR: Contribute to communications and promotional activity that builds awareness and reinforces brand messaging
- Performance & insights: Monitor marketing activity, prepare regular reports and identify opportunities to improve results
- Project collaboration: Work with colleagues across the business to develop ideas and deliver effective marketing initiatives
- Events & promotions: Assist with the organisation and delivery of events, exhibitions and other promotional activities
- New ideas: Keep up to date with digital trends, tools and best practice, bringing fresh thinking to the team

Skills & Experience Required:
- Previous experience in a digital marketing or broader marketing role, with a good understanding of digital channels and marketing principles
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills, with an eye for detail and the ability to create clear, engaging content
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects, meet deadlines and manage competing priorities
- A proactive, hands-on approach, taking ownership of tasks and seeing projects through from idea to delivery
- Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to build relationships with colleagues and stakeholders
- A commercial mindset, with an interest in understanding campaign performance and how marketing contributes to business growth
- Good IT skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Experience with Google Analytics or similar digital analytics tools would be advantageous, but isn t essential
- A full, valid UK driving licence (essential)

Benefits (Subject to Eligibility):
- A competitive salary package.
- Bonus opportunities.
- Enhanced pension contributions
- Healthcare and life assurance
- Enhanced annual leave
- A supportive, collaborative team environment
- The opportunity to work within a global, growing organisation
- Exposure to a varied mix of digital marketing, communications, PR, events and cross-functional projects
- The chance to make a tangible contribution to brand development and business success

title: Marketing Manager
description:
MARKETING MANAGER WICKFORD, ESSEX BASIC SALARY CIRCA £50k

What's the deal

At a time when many in the market are standing still, this family-run manufacturer is powering ahead. Turnover has more than doubled since we started working with them, driven by new products, five own brands and major investment across internal sales, field sales, and marketing.

Despite that growth, the business has kept everything that makes it special: exceptional people, down-to-earth leadership, quick decisions, and genuine trust. Now it needs a Marketing Manager to build on that momentum, raise the profile of its brands and play a key role in an exciting next chapter.

Your mission
- This is a hands-on role with room to think big. You'll set the direction, roll up your sleeves, and make sure great Ideas actually leave the whiteboard.
- Build and own a marketing plan that turns growth goals into campaigns people notice-and act on.
- Get close to customers, competitors, and market trends, turning insights into sharper positioning.
- Bring the brand to life across the website, social media, email, content, advertising, brochures, and sales tools.
- Plan and deliver launches, promotions, exhibitions, and trade campaigns from bright idea to brilliant execution.
- Work with sales, product teams, leaders, agencies, and suppliers so marketing is joined-up, useful and timely.
- Own the marketing calendar and budget, choosing the right channels instead of doing what's always been done.
- Track numbers, leads, engagement, conversion, revenue, and ROI-and use them to improve the next campaign.

The kind of person we're looking for
- Marketing Manager experience, ideally in B2 B, manufacturing, high volume construction products.
- Equal parts strategist and doer: shaping plans, writing briefs, and stepping in when deadlines need rescuing.
- A confident communicator who inspires enthusiasm and keeps everyone moving together.
- Creative, commercially minded, and curious about what makes customers tick.
- Comfortable with digital tools, campaign data, and budgets-you don't need to love spreadsheets but must understand them.
- Organised, proactive and low ego; comfortable with autonomy, collaboration and making a visible difference.

The Package
- Circa £50k basic
- 25 days' holiday + bank holidays
- Real autonomy, supportive leadership, and a role with genuine influence

Sound like your kind of move?

If you can turn a blank page into a campaign, a spreadsheet into a decision and 'we should probably market that' into something customers notice, we'd love to hear from you. This is your chance to shape the marketing function, make your mark and have some fun doing it.

title: Marketing Officer
description:
We are looking for a proactive Marketing Officer to support the promotion Firstsite and our activities, including our exhibitions, screenings, family activities, events, and our shop, café, and venue hire offerings.

You'll create engaging digital and print content, execute email and social campaigns, track and analyse campaign performance, and support the delivery of marketing initiatives across our vibrant venue and online platforms. This is a fantastic opportunity to expand your skills in a fast-paced, creative environment, working across a wide range of arts, culture, and commercial projects.

The Marketing Officer will report to the Marketing Manager and collaborate closely with teams across Firstsite to deliver cohesive, high-impact marketing in line with agreed strategies and audience plans.

title: Marketing Officer
description:
Marketing Officer Events

Location: Benfleet, Essex
Pay Rate: £16.30 per hour
Hours: Monday to Thursday, 8:30am 4:30pm (4 days per week)
Contract: Temporary until 29th October 2026

Are you a creative and organised marketing professional with a passion for events? Do you have experience bringing events to life, creating engaging marketing materials and communicating with a wide range of audiences?

Key Responsibilities
- Plan College events from conception through to completion.
- Coordinate Open Evenings, Graduation Ceremonies, Student Awards and other promotional activities.
- Create and develop marketing collateral, publications, prospectuses and event literature.
- Produce engaging internal and external communications across a variety of channels.
- Liaise with internal teams, external stakeholders and event attendees to ensure successful delivery.
- Monitor event effectiveness, manage attendee databases and support student recruitment and conversion activities.
- Manage event budgets, timelines and marketing materials.
- Support social media activity and make effective use of photography, video and digital content.
- Ensure all marketing materials and campus displays reflect the College s brand and standards.

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- A minimum of two years experience in marketing and/or events management.
- Proven experience organising and delivering events from start to finish.
- Experience developing marketing materials and creating engaging written content.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- High attention to detail and a creative, proactive approach to problem-solving.
- Confidence building relationships with a range of internal and external stakeholders.
- Good IT skills, with experience using databases and social media platforms.
- A flexible approach to working, including occasional evenings, early mornings and weekends.
- A full driving licence and access to your own transport.

A degree or equivalent professional experience is desirable.

If you feel like you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this Marketing Officer position, please apply with your CV.
